props.gloss_en: the mishnah: [one does not slaughter, neither in the Temple nor in the country, for] one with which a transgression was done -- [known] by one witness or by the owner
the mishnah: and one that killed a person -- [known] by one witness or by the owner
the mishnah: and a tumtum and an androginos -- neither in the Temple nor in the country
the baraita: garav is the cheres [the hard, earthenware-like scab]
the baraita: 'from the animal' -- to exclude one that copulated with a person and one that was the object of bestiality
the baraita: 'from the herd' -- to exclude one that was worshipped
the baraita: 'from the flock' -- to exclude one set aside [for idolatry]
the baraita: 'and from the flock' -- to exclude one that gored
the stam: granted the tumtum -- not in the Temple, for perhaps it is female; not in the country, for perhaps it is male and has no blemish
the stam: the androginos -- granted not in the Temple, for perhaps it is female

(entertained) a crack in a place of flesh is a blemish
